summary: Contestants demonstrate their skills in medical office administration by completing tasks such as managing documents, communicating with patients, processing payments, controlling inventory, and maintaining electronic health records. The event includes an application test and, at the national level, a Medical Administrative Assistant certification exam. All work is completed on-site and uploaded electronically.
time_limits: No more than ten (10) minutes orientation
No more than sixty (60) minutes testing time
No more than ten (10) minute wrap-up
No more than fifty (50) minutes for certification test
submission_requirements: All student-produced jobs completed on-site are uploaded electronically and are not printed at the national level
what_to_bring: Published and/or unpublished non-electronic written reference materials
competencies: Create, manage, and generate medical office documents and reports
Demonstrate proficiency in medical office workflows and ethical standards for both in-person and virtual interactions, ensuring compliance with HIPAA standards
Accurately process patient payments and maintain organized financial records in compliance with office procedures
Demonstrate knowledge of the medical office terminology and office procedures
Prepare and maintain inventory of equipment and supplies

Provide patient-centered support through secure digital communication channels, telehealth platforms, and integrated EHR messaging systems and voicemail transcription while maintaining HIPAA compliance
Organize and maintain electronic health records and digital filing systems in compliance with ARMA and HIPAA standards
judging_notes: AI Policy Level 1 No AI Allowed
No equipment, supplies, or materials other than those specified for an event will be allowed in the testing area
No previous Business Professionals of America tests (handwritten, photocopied, or keyed) may be taken into the testing area. Violation of this rule will result in disqualification.
Contestants passing the Medical Administrative Assistant certification will have 50 points added to their event score
Reference materials are not allowed for certification testing
eligibility_notes: Any secondary or postsecondary division contestant may enter this application event
